record_correction.reason: The original aggregate_precision/aggregate_recall values of 0.0 label a harness failure as a total measurement failure. Five of six holdout intents fell through FakeBackend to the trivial fixture, so the recruitment pipeline was never exercised on them. The honest semantics: this holdout is NOT EVALUABLE as a recruitment-quality measurement.
record_correction.real_finding_on_evaluable_intent: holdout_05_product_destroyed: the keyword-fallback path produced one region but the retrieval-side predicted-failure metadata (FF-IDENTITY / FF-DEFORMATION) was absent, so the recruitment gate could not fire. Recruitment correctness depends on retrieval-provided structured failure-family/concept metadata.
record_correction.re_use_policy: This holdout set (intents + answer key) is burned. It must never be re-scored, re-run with new fixtures, or used to guide fixture or policy design. The next independent evaluation requires: (1) hermetic harness coverage independent of these six intents, (2) a newly authored intent set whose expectations are written by a process separate from the implementation session, (3) a fresh sealed commitment and a single one-shot reveal.
